prompt:
Create a humanoid character animation similar to a “whirlwind” skill.
The character spreads both arms horizontally to the sides, as if holding a sword in each hand.
While keeping arms extended, the character spins rapidly around its vertical (Y) axis.
The rotation should be centered on the hips, with stable foot placement and slight knee bend.
Upper body remains upright, arms rigid, hands aligned forward as if gripping weapons.
Animation should loop cleanly and be suitable for a combat skill.
No jumping, no forward movement, rotation in place only.
